# Cooking Recipes

:material-pot-steam:{ aria-hidden="true" } <span class="fc-meta__kind">Recipe list</span> <span class="fc-meta__date">Updated 10 November 2026</span> [Data and sources](#sources)

This page lists all 125 Cooking recipes in the game client, build 1.60.1.70862. The headings are the headings of the in-game window. For the path from 1 to 300 and the recipe picks, see the [Cooking guide](cooking.md).

**Learn** is the skill that the client gives for the recipe. A dash shows a trainer recipe, because the client does not hold that skill. **Yellow** and **Grey** are the skills where the recipe changes colour. A **New** or **Changed** tag shows a recipe that is new or changed from Classic Era.
